summary: Implemented Phase 1 `BroadbandPulse` and `CustomSourceTime` source-time profiles with public API exposure, typed IR lowering, validation, and representative tests.
key_findings: `src/autofdtd/sources/time.py` now supports a clearly delimited `BroadbandPulse` subset by deriving an analytic Gaussian carrier from `(freq_range, minimum_amplitude)` and exposes `amp_time`, `amp_freq`, derived timing, and frequency metadata.

`CustomSourceTime` now stores explicit `time_samples` plus JSON-safe complex `(real, imag)` envelope pairs, validates monotonic sample layout, provides `from_values(...)`, and evaluates with linear interpolation plus nearest-value clamping outside the provided range.

`src/autofdtd/ir/models.py` and `src/autofdtd/ir/__init__.py` now lower both new source-time families into typed `BroadbandPulseIR` and `CustomSourceTimeIR` payloads so nested source definitions remain tagged and inspectable in execution packages.

Public exports were extended through `src/autofdtd/sources/__init__.py`, `src/autofdtd/api/simulation.py`, `src/autofdtd/api/__init__.py`, and `src/autofdtd/__init__.py`, and `phase1/working-memory.md` records the subset policy and serialization decision for later tasks.
